scene_sentence_zh: 廢棄的紫晶坑口撐著塌斜的木架，一道冷光自頂隙落下，照亮成堆的碎石地面。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: the mouth of an abandoned amethyst mine cut into a dark hillside, sagging timber props, violet crystal seams glittering in the rock face, a rusted iron rail ending in rubble, deep gloom broken by one cold shaft of daylight from a crack overhead, an open level floor of crushed stone below

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: A painterly JRPG mouth of an abandoned amethyst mine cut into a dark hillside, sagging timber props, violet crystal seams glittering in the rock, a rusted iron rail ending in rubble, one cold shaft of daylight from a crack overhead and a level floor of crushed stone. No figure, no creature, no readable lettering; the crystal face and shaft of light hold the upper two thirds.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop: the full-bleed composition holds at 1451x790: the crystal face and light shaft keep the upper band while the crushed-stone floor stays open below.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed on a ten-up contact sheet of the whole rite pack: each archetype reads as its own place — spring basin, stag statue, stone circle, sea tower, tree hollow, grave rows, crystal mine, sandstone arch, waterfall basin and capital plaza — with a consistent painterly palette and no two compositions alike.
